user.title: Mathlin Booking System
user.description: Enter the website URL and a WordPress user with an Application Password.

data_description.application_password: Create this in the WordPress user's profile.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Mathlin Booking System
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a WordPress username and Application Password for the booking API.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the website. Check the URL and try again.
error.invalid_auth: WordPress rejected the username or Application Password.
error.invalid_response: The booking API returned an unexpected response.
error.plugin_not_found: Connected to the website but the booking plugin API was not found.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid URL.

init.title: Booking Automation Timing
init.description: Configure how many minutes before and after each booking the automation events fire.

data_description.pre_event_minutes: Fire the booking_start event this many minutes before the booking begins.
data_description.post_event_minutes: Fire the booking_end event this many minutes after the booking finishes.
data_description.gap_minutes: Skip booking_end when another booking on the same space starts within this period.
